annotation.authors_or_issuer: Department of Health and Social Care (UK Secretary of State); King's Printer of Acts of Parliament
key_provisions_or_claims: Raises most medical device regulatory fees by roughly 9-16%, with clinical investigation fees rising more.
Introduces an optional hourly-fee regulatory advice meeting service (£987/hour) and omits pre-consultation meeting fees.
Lets small companies pay clinical investigation fees in two instalments (50% up front, 50% within six months).
Amends Medical Devices Regulations 2002, Blood Safety and Quality Regulations 2005, and NI Protocol Regulations 2021.
annotation.summary_en: UK statutory instrument (SI 2025/749) amending medical device, blood safety and Northern Ireland Protocol regulations to raise MHRA fees for device registration, notified/approved body designation and clinical investigations, add a paid regulatory advice service, and allow small companies to pay in instalments. No AI or robotics content.
